deep dive · what the creatives look like


Every typed creative was thumbnailed from the Ad Library (first image, or the video poster frame) and judged on what is visible in the frame, independently of the copy. Filters above apply. Click any thumbnail to open the ad in the Ad Library.






creative wall


Creatives with a captured thumbnail first, then ranked by days_running x variant_count within the current filter. Badge = visual type; second line = advertiser, days, variants, hook; third = indication and claim risk.

Ranked by days_running x variant_count within the current filter. variant_count sums Meta's collation count across identical creatives listed under separate ad ids.

Ad explorer





Judgments are text-based (Ad Library thumbnails are expiring URLs), so proof_asset reflects copy signals. Sofwave (ultrasound) and Thermage (RF) are outside the modality enum and coded unspecified; Halo is coded hybrid_multiple. Landing pages: "unclear" means the page failed to fetch or sat beyond the 300-page cap; nothing was inferred. Full method notes are in the companion report.
